title: [FLINK-41059][runtime] Schedule slot manager work on the main thread
body:
## What is the purpose of the change

`FineGrainedSlotManager` ran its delayed checks and periodic work on the RPC service's scheduler, which outlives the ResourceManager, and `suspend()` stopped only part of it. Everything now runs through the ResourceManager's main thread executor and stops in `suspend()`. Details in FLINK-41059.

## Brief change log

  - The test Context drives the slot manager through a `ComponentMainThreadExecutor`, optionally on the test thread.
  - Schedule delayed checks and periodic work on the main thread executor; cancel them in `suspend()`.
  - Clear the job state in `suspend()`; `clearResourceRequirements()` checks `started`, the `canBeReleased` reply checks the registration.
  - FLINK-34589: log a failed check and keep running.
  - FLINK-34588: the comments from #24309 on the ignored reconcile result.
  - `checkInit()`, `start()` and `suspend()` assert the main thread.

## Verifying this change

This change added tests and can be verified as follows:

  - Eight new tests in `FineGrainedSlotManagerTest`; the five for the guards and the logging fail without them.
  - `FineGrainedSlotManagerTest` 30 of 30, `FineGrainedSlotManagerDefaultResourceAllocationStrategyITCase` 18 of 18, `ResourceManagerTest`, `StandaloneResourceManagerTest` and `ActiveResourceManagerTest` 34 of 34, the `resourcemanager` package under `verify` 206 of 206, flink-runtime ITCases 403 of 403, none skipped.
